description: Remove symbols and sections from files.

option.name: --disable-deterministic-archives
tip: Disable -D behavior.

option.name: --discard-all
tip: Remove all non-global symbols.

option.name: --discard-locals
tip: Remove compiler-generated symbols.

option.name: --enable-deterministic-archives
tip: Produce deterministic output when stripping archives (default).

option.name: --help
tip: Display this output.

option.name: --info
tip: List the supported object formats and architectures.

option.name: --input-target
tip: Assume the input file is in the given format.

option.name: --keep-file-symbols
tip: Do not strip file symbols.

option.name: --keep-section
tip: Do not strip the named section.

option.name: --keep-section-symbols
tip: Do not strip section symbols.

option.name: --keep-symbol
tip: Do not strip the named symbol.

option.name: --merge-notes
tip: Remove redundant entries in note sections (default).

option.name: --no-merge-notes
tip: Do not remove redundant notes.

option.name: --only-keep-debug
tip: Strip everything but the debug information.

option.name: --output-target
tip: Create the output file in the given format.

option.name: --plugin
tip: Load the specified plugin.

option.name: --preserve-dates
tip: Copy modified and access timestamps to the output.

option.name: --remove-relocations
tip: Remove relocations from the named section.

option.name: --remove-section
tip: Also remove the named section from the output.

option.name: --strip-all
tip: Remove all symbol and relocation information.

option.name: --strip-debug
tip: Remove all debugging symbols and sections.

option.name: --strip-dwo
tip: Remove all DWO sections.

option.name: --strip-section-headers
tip: Strip section headers from the output.

option.name: --strip-symbol
tip: Do not copy the named symbol.

option.name: --strip-unneeded
tip: Remove all symbols not needed by relocations.

option.name: --target
tip: Set both the input and output format.

option.name: --verbose
tip: List all object files modified.

option.name: --version
tip: Display the program version.

option.name: --wildcard
tip: Permit wildcards in symbol comparison.

option.name: -o
tip: Place the stripped output into the file.
